examples.notes: Bracket legs use deltas from the entry working price, in contract-native price units. Both legs compute entryPrice + delta; the server does not flip signs based on order side. Long: profitTarget positive (above entry), stopLoss negative (below entry). Short: profitTarget negative (below entry), stopLoss positive (above entry).
examples.title: Market buy with bracket (TP 10 points above entry, SL 5 points below)

examples.notes: For a short the caller supplies profitTarget negative (target below entry) and stopLoss positive (stop above entry).
examples.title: Market sell with bracket (TP 10 points below entry, SL 5 points above)
